title: Fix numeric refinementlist page
body:
Fixes #2195 

The numericRefinementList was not reseting the page when refining, so the infiniteHits could not know it was new results from the first page.

comments.body: This should be backported to v1 since the bug is present https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/widgets/numeric-refinement-list/numeric-refinement-list.js#L158-L205

Deploy preview ready!

Built with commit bd5bddae5f7c94ab78bafc4484738f3da3c248c0

https://deploy-preview-2202--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com

> 36 lines of test for 2 (with a blank line) of fix. GG 👍

Should we export the refinement methods and only test them to avoid having to set a complex fixture to do a one line change?

As soon as we have a stable codebase like now (where we know we will have those refine methods for long), we could test those refine methods by units rather than having to render a full widget.

(thinking out loud)
